Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pihu - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Ishaan - 11 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
5. Savitri - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's do something fun today."

[It starts to rain.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Anita (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Mom, look at this."

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Nikhil (gently): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Pihu, Anita and Ishaan stand near him.]

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil goes jogging in the park.]

Pihu: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Anita: "That was fun!"

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Nikhil: "Ishaan, look at this."

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Anita (excited): "That's great!"

[Pihu skips rope.]

Pihu: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The road - Day

Ishaan: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil rides his bicycle down the road.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Nikhil (gently): "How beautiful!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Pihu and Anita stand near him.]

Pihu: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Pihu applies kajal to her eyes.]

Pihu (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Nikhil: "Okay, Pihu."

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Anita: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil irons his school shirt.]

Pihu: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil knocks on the door.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
